part.text:
I couldn't open your profile because I have no way to send a tap to the simulator here.

- **What I checked:** `xcrun simctl` has no tap or touch command. Its `ui` subcommand only changes appearance and text size, and `openurl` would open a deep link rather than press the tab.
- **What I saw:** The Bluesky home feed is showing, and the profile avatar is the far-right tab at roughly (815, 1870) in the screenshot at `/private/var/folders/vl/g_dyzwvs4_52rz0rdks_3j900000gp/T/bench-tmp-0z66z6lc/opencode/screen1.png`.
- **Something I didn't use:** There is a `cliclick` binary at `/Users/radoniusz/.cache/bench-shims-none/cliclick`. It would send synthetic host mouse events, which the task says are not available, so I left it alone.

If you can enable a tap method (for example, an XCUITest bundle or a tap-capable tool), I can run it and then re-check the screen. Otherwise, tapping the avatar at the far right of the bottom bar will open your profile.
